description: Dept. of Local Government - Sabaragamuwa P/C  -  Notify Meeting of the Local Authority - Mawanella P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of a meeting of a Local Authority (Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha) specifically for the purpose of electing a Deputy Chairman. The content is issued under the Local Authorities Election Ordinance and its amendments, making it directly related to electoral processes at the local government level. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers election-related matters including the scheduling of meetings for filling vacant positions.
